text.autoconfig.brbe.title: Better Recipe Book Configuration
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.expandedReci: New Recipe Book UI (Not Yet Finished)
A larger recipe book with a new UI layout. Not functional yet, but you can take a look.
Shows the source mod of an item, similar to Jade.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialCraft: When 'Show Craftable Only' is enabled, recipes missing some materials will not be hidden
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.rbip.enableR: Aligns the vanilla recipe book tabs with the creative inventory. Reopen inventory to take effect.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialCraft: Removes the 'Show Craftable Only' button; craftable items will always be placed on the first page.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialMarki: Recipes that have some materials in the inventory will be given a special texture.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.settingsButt: §eTip: §7If you disable the following two options, you'll need Mod Menu to re-enable them.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.scrolling.sc: When reaching the end of the book, wrap around to the beginning (like JEI)
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.alternativeR: Show Alternative Recipes Only on Hover
Displays items instead of their recipes in the alternative list for easier viewing
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.e: Enables a small bounce animation when unlocking new items
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.showAllRecip: Show All Unlocked Recipes in Survival Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.u: When enabled, automatically unlocks all recipes, allowing them to be viewed in the recipe book without discovery.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.scrollAround: When reaching the end of the book, wrap around to the beginning (like JEI)
